rack: EMBER REED, HALLORAN's analog voice (an example rack's faceplate)
coordinate_space: each view's own plate pixels at the house pitch; the host stacks the face, the deck while open, and the front, and scales the whole rack uniformly

rack_pitch.note: EIA: 19 in panel, 1.75 in per unit

face.conversion: closed.png's box from x 13 y 80 scaled by 0.9972041006523765 on both axes, then 409 scaled rows planned to 394

deck.conversion: open.png's box from x 9.8100004196167 y 346.12 scaled by 1.411470772331743 on both axes, then 700 scaled rows planned to 788; the runners outside the flat panel stretched; its pixels deck-sharp.png's, registered by ECC onto that box and given open.png's tone

front.conversion: closed.png's box from x 13 y 493 scaled by 0.9972041006523765 on both axes, then 96 scaled rows planned to 197

bindings: each element binds its rack unit (an index into the design's units) and the unit module's local key; the host resolves the registry parameter per placed rack

face:plate.source: ember-reed/closed.png, through the approved spike's extracted plate (pointers, fader caps and the lamp's glow removed, the lens unlit)
face:plate.note: the approved spike's plate (pointers, fader caps and the lamp's glow removed, the lens unlit), scaled to the panel and 15 plain rows dropped

front:plate.note: the drawer front with its finger pull, scaled and plain rows repeated above and below the pull

deck:plate.source: ember-reed/deck-sharp.png, registered onto open.png's deck (pointers and bats removed)
deck:plate.note: the PROGRAMMER deck from deck-sharp.png, registered onto open.png's deck and sampled at 0.985 of its size, its pointers and bats removed (caps rebuilt from their own pixels), plain rows repeated

face:air.knurl.source: the approved spike's grip strip (the drawn ring rebuilt with even teeth), resampled to the face's scale
